headline: Databricks Assistant vs Genie vs Data Agent: A 2026 Buyer Guide
description: Lakehouse buyer guide for databricks assistant vs genie: compare Assistant, Genie, and Data Agents on governance, memory, and rollout fit in 2026. See the FAQ.
keywords: databricks assistant vs genie, databricks genie, databricks assistant, data agent lakehouse

mainEntity.name: What is the difference in Databricks Assistant vs Genie?

acceptedAnswer.text: Databricks Assistant helps you write and fix code in notebooks. Databricks Genie lets you ask natural-language questions over governed lakehouse tables. Assistant targets builders; Genie targets data consumers inside the workspace.

mainEntity.name: Is Databricks Genie a Data Agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: Partially. Genie moves toward agent-like NL analytics with catalog grounding, but most deployments remain workspace-bound with guided exploration. Full Data Agents add cross-system orchestration, distilled memory, and multi-entry parity.

mainEntity.name: Can we use Assistant and Genie together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Common pattern: Assistant for pipeline engineering, Genie for analyst self-service on curated gold tables. Add a Data Agent when KPIs cross systems or require API/chat delivery.

mainEntity.name: When should we add InfiniSynapse if we already have Genie?

acceptedAnswer.text: When answers require sources outside Databricks, when executives need non-workspace access, or when monthly metrics must replay from memory without re-negotiating definitions.

mainEntity.name: How does the AI data analyst role fit?

acceptedAnswer.text: Humans owning goal framing, metric governance, and sign-off; agents owning multi-step execution. The ai data analyst role pairs with Data Agents for accountable hybrid analytics.
